measure_name: Climate-informed siting, routing and deployment choice
definition: Selection or modification of infrastructure location, route or deployment mode to reduce exposure to an identified natural hazard. Includes relocation, geographic separation of critical sites and hazard-driven choices between buried and aerial cables or terrestrial and satellite deployment. Assessing options alone is cra; protective engineering features are resilient_infrastructure_design. Adding an alternative communications path is network_redundancy. Includes rules and plans specifically about hazard-informed siting, such as tower-siting rules. Excludes ordinary network planning and targeting vulnerable communities for support without reducing infrastructure exposure.
boundary: Not assessing options alone, which is cra; not protective engineering features, which are resilient_infrastructure_design; not adding an alternative communications path, which is network_redundancy.
